segments.zh: 我想这样做是因为他知道。

segments.en: He knew that it was a fake dollar bill.
segments.zh: 他知道那是一张假的美元钞票。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And this is interesting as well because it's kind of like a metaphor.
segments.zh: 这也很有趣，因为它有点像一个隐喻。

segments.en: He said the boss said you're using the small technical glitches as a crutch.
segments.zh: 他说老板说你用的是小技术故障作为拐杖。

segments.en: So using something as a crutch.
segments.zh: 所以用东西当拐杖。

segments.en: Now the crutch is a you know when you when you break your leg you use those wooden or metal sticks to walk with.
segments.zh: 现在拐杖是你知道的时候，当你折断腿时，你会用那些木棍或金属棍子走路。

segments.en: OK to help you walk.
segments.zh: 可以帮你走路。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So the boss is basically saying you're using these technical glitches as an excuse or as an aid to why you missed the deadline.
segments.zh: 所以老板基本上是在说你用这些技术故障作为借口或帮助你错过最后期限的原因。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So if you think about it like this some people might say OK if you walk with a crutch then you you won't succeed.
segments.zh: 所以如果你这样想，有些人可能会说如果你拄着拐杖走路，你就不会成功。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Because whatever.
segments.zh: 因为无论如何。

segments.en: So this guy this employee is basically saying yes I know that I should meet deadlines but these these problems these glitches are like my crutch that make me not succeed.
segments.zh: 所以这个员工基本上是在说是的，我知道我应该按时完成，但这些问题就像我的拐杖，让我没有成功。

segments.en: OK.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So he's trying to just make excuses.
segments.zh: 所以他只是想找借口。

segments.en: So God Marco that is a little bit difficult to understand.
segments.zh: 所以上帝马可有点难以理解。

segments.en: Do you think we should give a couple more examples.
segments.zh: 你认为我们应该再举几个例子。

segments.en: Yeah I think I think some more examples would be very useful.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为更多的例子会非常有用。

segments.en: So let's listen to a couple of them now.
segments.zh: 所以让我们现在听听他们中的几个。

segments.en: Example one.
segments.zh: 例句一。

segments.en: I realized that I was using alcohol as a crutch to get through the day.
segments.zh: 我意识到我用酒精作为拐杖来度过这一天。

segments.en: Example two.
segments.zh: 例句二。

segments.en: I think Bill's very capable of being successful but he uses his disability as a crutch example three.
segments.zh: 我认为比尔非常有能力取得成功，但他将他的残疾作为拐杖示例三。

segments.en: Stop using your weight as a crutch just because you're a bit fat doesn't mean you can't get a great job.
segments.zh: 仅仅因为你有点胖就停止把你的体重当作拐杖，并不意味着你找不到一份好工作。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So a lot of great phrases great words and well I think it's time for us to listen to this dialogue for the last time and then we'll come back and talk about this aspect of meeting deadlines.
segments.zh: 所以很多很棒的短语很棒的词，我认为是时候让我们最后一次听这个对话了，然后我们会回来讨论在最后期限之前的这方面。

segments.en: And so I just wanted to check in with you and find out where we are with this project.
segments.zh: 我想跟你核对一下，了解项目进展到哪儿了。

segments.en: As you know you've missed a fairly significant deadline last week and this will negatively impact the team's ability to move forward with the next stages of this project.
segments.zh: 如您所知，上周您错过了相当重要的最后期限，这将对团队在该项目的下一阶段继续前进的能力产生负面影响。

segments.en: I know I'm really sorry that I missed the deadline but really it wasn't my fault.
segments.zh: 我知道我真的很抱歉我错过了最后期限，但这真的不是我的错。

segments.en: You see we had all of these unexpected technical problems at the last minute and I couldn't get into the database and extract the kind of information that I needed for the data analysis.
segments.zh: 最后关头突然出了不少技术问题，我进不了数据库，也提取不到数据分析需要的信息。

segments.en: You know if the tech guys would have done their job and kept the CRM stable then I wouldn't have missed my deadline.
segments.zh: 要是技术团队做好本职工作，保证客户关系管理系统稳定，我就不会错过期限了。

segments.en: Oh come on.
segments.zh: 哦，来吧。

segments.en: An excuse like that is tantamount to lying.
segments.zh: 这种借口跟说谎没什么两样。

segments.en: You're essentially blaming the tech team for your time management issues rather than accepting responsibility for the fact that you were procrastinating for the past two weeks.
segments.zh: 你过去两周一直拖延，却把自己的时间管理问题怪到技术团队头上，不肯担责。

segments.en: No I'm not trying to pass the buck here.
segments.zh: 不，我不是想推卸责任。

segments.en: I know it was me who was ultimately responsible for getting this done.
segments.zh: 我知道最终负责完成这项工作的人是我。

segments.en: But the thing is I could have finished on time if the system hadn't gone down.
segments.zh: 可要是系统没有瘫痪，我就能按时做完。

segments.en: And you know with everything I've got going on now I can't afford to waste time dealing with technical problems.
segments.zh: 我现在忙的事太多，实在没时间耗在技术故障上。

segments.en: I've got a lot on my plate and there are only 24 hours in a day.
segments.zh: 我手头的事一大堆，一天却只有二十四小时。

segments.en: I'm not going to accept this excuse.
segments.zh: 我不会接受这个借口。

segments.en: You're using these small technical glitches as a crutch and trying to rationalize the fact that you've missed your deadline.
segments.zh: 你拿这些小技术故障当挡箭牌，替错过截止日期找理由。

segments.en: Look we have standards and I expect you to live up to those standards.
segments.zh: 我们有工作标准，我希望你能达到。

segments.en: No more phony excuses.
segments.zh: 别再编借口了。

segments.en: If you're in over your head you tell me.
segments.zh: 如果工作已经超出你的能力，就告诉我。

segments.en: No more missed deadlines.
segments.zh: 以后不能再误期。

segments.en: Now I want that data on my desk by 9 a.m.
segments.zh: 明早九点前把数据放到我桌上。

segments.en: This employee got in a lot of trouble for missing his deadline.
segments.zh: 这位员工因错过最后期限而陷入了很多麻烦。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: I think it's a very important aspect of not only Western culture but also in general assuming guilt when it's your fault.
segments.zh: 我认为这不仅是西方文化的一个非常重要的方面，而且在你的错时一般会假设内疚。

segments.en: In this case we saw that the employee didn't really want to accept the fact that it was his fault.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，我们看到员工真的不想接受这是他的错的事实。

segments.en: He didn't say yeah I know it was me I'm sorry and this is my plan to fix it.
segments.zh: 他没有说是的，我知道这是我，我很抱歉，这是我修复它的计划。

segments.en: Now this is very important among cultures because in some cultures the aspect of losing face is so important right?
segments.zh: 现在这在文化中非常重要，因为在某些文化中，丢脸的方面如此重要，对吧？

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So somebody may not really want to assume guilt or they have to because it's part of the culture.
segments.zh: 所以有人可能真的不想承担内疚，或者他们不得不这样做，因为这是文化的一部分。

segments.en: But what's the standard in North American business practice?
segments.zh: 但是北美商业实践的标准是什么？

segments.en: I would say that you would have to assume responsibility and take responsibility for your actions right and say yes it's my fault I did it but I'm going to get it fixed or I'll do it or I'll make up for it.
segments.zh: 我会说你必须承担责任并为你的行为承担责任，并说是的，这是我的错，我做到了，但我会解决它，否则我会去做，否则我会弥补。

segments.en: So some good business tips here today in this lesson.
segments.zh: 所以今天在本课中有一些很好的商业技巧。

segments.en: Now remember if you have any questions about the language or want to tell us a little bit about how you assume responsibility in your culture visit our website at EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 现在请记住，如果您对该语言有任何疑问，或者想告诉我们一些关于您如何在您的文化中承担责任的信息，请访问我们的网站 englishpod.com。

segments.en: Right we're always there to help you out and until next time.
segments.zh: 是的，我们随时为您提供帮助，直到下一次。

segments.en: Thanks for listening and goodbye!
segments.zh: 感谢您的收听和再见！
